name: @chewygumxx/skill-coordinating-agents
description: Hands work to Codex, Claude subagents and a reserve account by usage budget, runs long jobs as systemd units, messages agents in herdr, and recovers when context or usage runs out. Use when dispatching work to Codex or a Claude subagent, routing a job by usage budget, running a job that may outlast a usage window, arming a wake-up, messaging another agent in herdr, or when your context passes 85% and you would compact yourself.
